== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The +3 forfeit condition moves from ‘at a Rebel War Room’ to ‘while at your War Room.’ The location predicate changes from classification to the player's own location. Astromech symbol/Nav Computer terminology denotes the same icon under the period rules. Hyperspeed and hyperdrive clauses otherwise agree.
